scenes.title: April 2011 BrainGate2 Clinical Room — Robotic Arm Grasping & Lifting the Coffee Bottle
scenes.era: 2011–2012 clinical neurotechnology laboratory at Massachusetts General Hospital / Brown BrainGate2 trial site
scenes.recognition_hook: A multi-joint brushed-silver five-fingered robotic arm mounted beside a motorized wheelchair smoothly grasping a cylindrical insulated coffee bottle with a straw from a tabletop and lifting it steadily under pure motor-cortex control.

layout.room: Bright clinical neuroengineering trial room with a clean cool-toned adjustable tabletop positioned in front of a motorized wheelchair and a pedestal-mounted multi-joint silver robotic arm on the right side

positions.who: Participant S3 seated in motorized wheelchair (staged strictly from behind / neck-down in Schema v7)
positions.where: centered behind the cool tabletop edge
positions.facing: forward toward the cylindrical insulated bottle and silver robotic arm

positions.where: mounted on a sturdy silver support base to the right of the tabletop
positions.facing: articulating inward across 3D space toward the cylindrical coffee bottle and straw

positions.who: Two BrainGate2 clinical engineers in lab coat and slate blazer
positions.where: standing behind the neural signal monitor cart at the rear left
positions.facing: watching the robotic fingers close cleanly around the insulated bottle

props.name: Brushed-silver multi-joint five-fingered robotic arm
props.period_detail: Sleek articulated silver robotic limb (modeled on DLR Light-Weight Robot III + five-fingered hand) with smooth cylindrical joints and five articulated silver fingers
props.physical_behavior: Glides smoothly along 3D X-Y-Z trajectories, opens its five silver fingers wide, closes firmly around the cylindrical bottle, lifts upward without wobble, tilts slightly, and sets the bottle cleanly back down

props.name: Cylindrical insulated coffee bottle with angled drinking straw
props.period_detail: Matte pastel cylindrical insulated thermos bottle fitted with a clean bent drinking straw resting upright on a cool slate-stone tabletop
props.physical_behavior: Rests upright on the table until grasped by the five silver robotic fingers, rises smoothly off the stone surface, tilts steadily at straw height, and returns upright to the table

props.name: 4-millimeter 96-channel silicon cortical array model
props.period_detail: Tiny 4x4 mm square brushed-silver and powder-blue silicon sensor bed holding an 10x10 grid of 96 fine 1.5 mm pins
props.physical_behavior: Sits delicately beside a small pastel tablet disk for scale and transmits crisp cyan spike wave pulses along a slim silver cable

scenes.wardrobe: Participant dressed in a comfortable powder-blue cardigan seated in a slate motorized wheelchair (strictly rear / neck-down framing); clinical researchers in crisp white coat and charcoal blazer with cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hands.
scenes.lighting: Even bright clinical daylight with cool mist-white, powder-blue, sage-green, and brushed-silver tones; zero harsh shadows or warm wood.
actions: Silver five-fingered robotic hand glides forward and opens around the cylindrical insulated bottle on the cool slate-stone table
Five articulated silver fingers close smoothly around the bottle and lift it steadily upward toward straw height
Researchers step back in quiet astonishment as the robotic arm lowers the bottle upright onto the tabletop and releases cleanly
reactions: Clinicians behind the neural decoder cart raise gloved hands in celebration after the fourth successful self-served coffee trial

key_visual.description: Close-to-medium view of the brushed-silver five-fingered robotic hand closing gently around the matte pastel insulated coffee bottle with straw and lifting it cleanly off the cool slate-stone tabletop beside a rear-viewed wheelchair silhouette.

scenes.title: 3D Foam-Ball Target Reach-and-Grasp Calibration
scenes.recognition_hook: Articulated silver robotic hand reaching across different heights to grasp pastel spherical foam targets mounted on flexible stalks.

layout.room: Cool mist-white clinical lab bench holding four pastel foam spheres mounted at varied heights on slender flexible silver stalks

positions.where: right side of cool slate-stone bench
positions.facing: reaching across X, Y, and Z axes toward elevated pastel spheres

props.name: Pastel foam target spheres on flexible silver stalks
props.period_detail: Soft matte mint-sage and powder-blue spheres perched at staggered 3D heights
props.physical_behavior: Flex gently without breaking when grasped by the robotic fingers within the 10-second trial window

scenes.wardrobe: Cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly engineer hands in white coat cuffs adjusting target stalks.
actions: Engineer places staggered pastel spheres at high, middle, and low positions
Silver robotic hand glides upward and closes cleanly around the elevated mint-sage sphere
reactions: Cyan indicator bars rise on a blank geometric display as 3D grasps succeed

scenes.title: 2017 Functional Electrical Stimulation Own-Arm Follow-Up
scenes.recognition_hook: Motor-cortex signals routed around the spinal injury into a cushioned arm support and sleeve pads so a clothed forearm lifts a cup directly.

layout.room: Bright cool-toned rehabilitation desk with a mobile spring-balanced forearm support cradle

positions.who: Clothed forearm in powder-blue sleeve resting in silver mobile arm support
positions.facing: extending toward a matte sage-green cup with straw

props.name: Cushioned forearm stimulation band and mobile support cradle
props.period_detail: Soft mist-white cuff bands linked by slim silver leads to a decoder box
props.physical_behavior: Delivers gentle cyan pulses enabling the gloved hand itself to close around a cup

scenes.wardrobe: Powder-blue shirt sleeve and cool porcelain-white gloved low-poly hand.
actions: Cyan signal bypasses the blocked spinal path and enters the forearm cuff
Gloved low-poly hand closes around the matte sage-green cup and lifts it smoothly
reactions: Researcher beside the desk nods and steadies the decoder cable
